name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to wall line freehand with brush, then roll primer onto bare drywall ceiling with an 18-inch roller on extension pole. Single coat of primer. Rolling overhead is significantly slower than rolling walls — both the cut-in and the field roll rates are ~80% of wall prime rates.
doctrine: Cut-in rate (85 LF/hr) is meaningfully slower than wall cut-in (100 LF/hr) because the painter is brushing overhead with the wrist inverted. Roll rate baseline (300 SF/hr) is the smooth rate — ~85% of wall primer roll rates. FAC_TEXTURE handles the textured slowdown; tune there. The painter is using an extension pole which adds reach but reduces fine control. QT4 slowdown stacks on FAC_QT separately from texture.
